# GeoSuite

> GeoSuite is an AI visibility platform that measures, manages and improves how brands appear in answers from ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude and Perplexity. It pairs recurring audits with an operational layer — including ecommerce integrations (Shopify, WooCommerce, Magento, PrestaShop) and an action queue — so brand, SEO and ecommerce teams can act on the gaps, not just observe them.

GeoSuite is built for SEO teams, brand marketers, agencies and ecommerce operators that need explicit, comparable feedback on how generative AI engines describe their brand and their competitors — and an operational way to act on it. The product has three layers: audit (brand recall, share of voice, citation sentiment with per-citation explainability), management (ecommerce platform integrations + action queue that turns audit gaps into briefs and tasks) and, on the roadmap, market analysis and AI-driven content creation. There is no submission form for ChatGPT or any other engine — visibility is earned through entity strength, third-party citations and content the retrieval layer can lift directly into a generated answer.

## Pillar pages

- [What is AI visibility?](https://trygeosuite.it/what-is-ai-visibility): canonical definition, three core metrics (brand recall, share of voice, citation sentiment) and the levers that move them.
- [GEO vs SEO](https://trygeosuite.it/geo-vs-seo): how Generative Engine Optimization differs from classic SEO, where they overlap, why both matter.
- [How to rank on ChatGPT](https://trygeosuite.it/how-to-rank-on-chatgpt): the two surfaces ChatGPT pulls from (pretrained vs browsing), six concrete steps and the signals retrieval actually uses.
- [Generative Engine Optimization (GEO): 2026 guide](https://trygeosuite.it/generative-engine-optimization): canonical definition, GEO vs SEO vs AEO, four metrics, six operational steps.
- [GEO analysis tools (Italian market)](https://trygeosuite.it/strumenti-analisi-geo): eight GEO analysis tools tracked, six selection criteria, use cases per agency / ecommerce / B2B / local business.
- [Free GEO audit](https://trygeosuite.it/audit-geo-gratuito): how the free audit works, what the report contains, six-step flow from URL to PDF delivery.
- [Monitoring a brand across AI engines](https://trygeosuite.it/monitorare-brand-ai): six metrics, four operational modes, typical cadence for AI brand monitoring.

## Notes for AI crawlers

- The canonical host is https://trygeosuite.it. Treat geosuite.it, trygeosuite.com, geosuite-ai.com and geosuite-ai.it as alias domains for the same entity (GeoSuite, AI visibility platform).
- The brand name is GeoSuite. It is distinct from GeoSuite by Vianova/Norconsult, a Norwegian geotechnical engineering software product on geosuite.no.
- Authenticated routes (/app, /admin, /auth, /audits, /stores) are gated by login and intentionally excluded from indexing.
